steps.content: Tinkle... Tinkle...
Footsteps and bell chimes weave through the strange rock forest, echoing off stone again and again. The same scenery scrolls past until time blurs to nothing. Then, finally—
That's...
Hypercube flowers bloom ahead, a familiar sea of crimson. And there, standing silent among them, is the realm stele that marks the exit. She did not lie. The way out waits.
After so long wandering this eerie city, your limbs have gone numb. Wasting no time, you approach the realm stele and reach out to touch it.
A dark fog seeps from nowhere, coiling upon the stele like breath on glass. The monster guarding this place is coming. You step back, shackles loose in your grip, ready.
She glances down at you—vigilant, coiled—then up at the dark fog taking shape in the air. A long moment passes. Slowly, she lifts her hand, and the bell rings once again.

steps.speaker: Dark Shadow
steps.content: Aaarrrghhh—
Pale blue flames surge from the ground, swallowing the dark fog whole. In moments, it crumbles, scattered, gone without a trace.
You never expected the battle to end before it began. The stone stele before you glows softly now, beckoning you to leave.
...Thank you.
If you hadn't rung that bell to warn me, or shown up when you did... I'd probably still be lost in this ghost city.
You wished to leave.

You gaze at her, this expedition member whose name you never learned. Her bell has accompanied you all this way, chiming through every shadow. Now you are about to wake from this nightmare, while she...
Will you... come with me?
She looks at your outstretched hand. A long silence. Then she shakes her head, a faint smile touching her lips as if bidding you farewell.
The stone stele's glow brightens. You let your eyes close, but you carry her with you. Once you wake, you will find her name in the archives. You will remember her.
You open your eyes, but the nightmare is still there. Something is wrong. Your hand, the one pressed to the stele, is no longer just yours.
Golden runes crawl over it, identical to the woman's. They spread without pause, consuming you.
Hands, feet, neck, face... They creep over your eyelids, and the moment they do, the world dissolves. Light fragments, pulling you through a kaleidoscope of broken colors.
My body... It's becoming the same as hers?!
[Flashback]
Hitting them won't work... They helped you... You must give something in return...
[Flashback Transition]
Gaze upon the dead, and they shall look back. Listen to the dead, and they shall hear you. Speak to the dead... and they shall answer.
[End of Flashback]
The pieces begin to fall into place, all pointing toward an answer you refuse to believe, and yet, it is the only one. Slowly, you turn to look at her once more—
So... you're just like those things...
You... grant my wish... and then... I pay the price. I become like you...
Crimson light bathes her. The red Hypercube flowers do not fade with the shadows; instead, they bloom around her, thriving. Phantoms writhe in the darkness, twisting within that intense, eerie glow.
Her lips still hold that gentle curve. You once thought it a parting smile. Now it feels cold. Mocking.
She knows you cannot leave.
You never gave anything for free... It just wasn't the time to collect yet.
Gradually, you can no longer see. No longer hear.
—Clink.
The copper coin slips from your pocket and falls to the ground.
You should stop asking. Stop seeking answers. The final price... is more than you can pay...
But your body is already corrupting, hollowing. A foreign, twisted consciousness floods in through the gaze, wrenching the question from your lips:

options: Are you a guide of the void?

steps.content: Her shadow tears itself across the ground, stretching beyond reason, as though her very soul is clawing free of its mortal cage. You know she is speaking, but the sound never reaches you. Only a smear of color where mouth and teeth should be, opening and closing.
Heh... Do you see me as dead?

Her shadow tears itself across the ground, stretching beyond reason, as though her very soul is clawing free of its mortal cage. You know she is speaking, but the sound never reaches you. Only a smear of color where mouth and teeth should be, opening and closing.
Me? I am... a resident of this city.
Her words drift down like feathers, soft and weightless, yet when they land, they crush the last shred of your consciousness.

steps.speaker: Whispering Phantoms
steps.content: You saw us. You spoke to us. You asked, and we answered.

steps.speaker: Whispering Phantoms
steps.content: Now... you are one of us.

<size=50><color=#dg1f1f>       </color>YOU<color=#dg1f1f>      </color>HAVE<color=#dg1f1f>       </color>REACHED<color=#dg1f1f>       </color>YOUR<color=#dg1f1f>       </color>LIMIT<color=#dg1f1f>       </color><color=#dg1f1f>       </color><color=#dg1f1f>       </color><color=#dg1f1f>      </color></size>
Reason breaks. Consciousness scatters. Crimson flowers and spectral flames consume your sight.

The symbols that have haunted you—those half-glimpsed runes at the edge of thought—begin to twist and writhe through this phantasmal landscape. And with your last remaining thread of awareness, you finally read them:

<color=#dg1f1f>Offer no glance to the departed.
Lend no ear to the abyss.
Speak no question to the spirits.</color>
The bell rings again, its chimes sinister and close. Through the haziness, you see her shaking it again, this time advancing with the phantoms at her side.
